name: Strange Man
source:
An androgynous man who appeared in Rinka's dreams.
He seems to live in the dream world, but it's unknown if he has any ties to Parca. Rinka has no recollection of meeting him.

[From [url=http://fatal12.com/en.html]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]He's Lethe the cat, which [url=/c60242]Rinka[/url] takes care of and named Leo when [url=/c60243]Dianna[/url] was still alive.[/spoiler]
